achievements.name: First Hearthroot
achievements.detail: Discover a Hearthroot grove and use it to recover between battles.

achievements.name: Quest Finished
achievements.detail: Complete a side quest picked up while choosing a route through Talamh.

achievements.name: Co-op Clear
achievements.detail: Complete one full run while another player fights next to you, locally or online.

achievements.name: Sun King Fallen
achievements.detail: Fight through to the tower and defeat Sun King Azra.

achievements.name: Six Clashes
achievements.detail: As Galandra, win six Clashes before the level you are fighting through ends.

achievements.name: Pit Toss
achievements.detail: Use Karl's throw so three enemies drop into a pit together.

achievements.name: Long Airtime
achievements.detail: Keep Cider airborne for a full fifteen seconds during a fight.

achievements.name: Arcana Burst
achievements.detail: While playing Brome, unleash ten Arcana spells before the current area ends.

achievements.name: Wild Combo
achievements.detail: Chain hits until a single combo earns the game's strongest callout.

achievements.name: All Regions
achievements.detail: Set foot in every region on the map of Talamh.

achievements.name: Friendly Mounts
achievements.detail: Stop and pet each of the four mount species found around Talamh.

achievements.name: Full Company
achievements.detail: Fill the party until four hired allies or summons are fighting beside you together.

achievements.name: No Rest
achievements.detail: Defeat the Sun King on a journey that skips every haven and Hearthroot rest.
